instructions.description: Commits are authored by the repository owner. Leave findings as comments; never push commits or suggest co-author lines.
ADR 0007: every coordinator state change is appended to the write-ahead log before any reply depends on it. Flag a reply, cleanup or state change observable before its record is logged.
The Python coordinator mirrors the Go coordinator (#36). Flag a behavior or gRPC status-code change in one that the other lacks, unless the PR links an issue for it.
Timeouts, heartbeats and retry timers use the monotonic clock (Go time.Since/time.Now with its monotonic reading; Python _clock or time.monotonic), not the wall clock.
proto/ is shared by Go and Python. Flag renumbered or removed fields and changed semantics; these need an ADR.
Commands, flags, defaults and metric names in docs must match the code; relative links must resolve.
